title: figma-library-map
description: Read-only census of a Figma component/style library: the join table from a component or style NAME to its published KEY, plus each component's property axes. Lane A (figma-library-census) emits; Lanes B, F, G read (plan-sheerline-fdde-loop-2026-09-07 section 3.3). Version 1.0; additive thereafter. Fields library[]/components[]/styles[] are the binding section 3.3 shape; schema_version and provenance are additive provenance.

provenance.description: Additive. Where and when the census ran. Never carries a client name; the file_key of an engagement library lives only in the gitignored proof record.

library.description: The published libraries this census covers. library_key is read from a CONSUMING file's get_libraries; it is null when the census ran against the defining file alone (no consumer). file_key is the Figma file; it is redacted to a placeholder in any tracked file and recorded verbatim only in the gitignored proof record.

components.description: Published COMPONENT and COMPONENT_SET rows. Variant child components are NOT rows; the set is the row. properties are read from the property-owning node (a COMPONENT_SET owns its definitions; a variant COMPONENT delegates to its parent set).

values.description: VARIANT: the variant options. BOOLEAN: ["true","false"]. TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP/SLOT: empty (open-valued).

default_variant.description: The default variant combination string (e.g. "Style=primary, Size=sm, State=default") for a COMPONENT_SET; null for a standalone COMPONENT.

styles.description: Published text and effect styles. Paint styles are out of scope for v1 (the system binds fills to color variables, not paint styles).
